The challenge intensity is strongly tied to rising movement speed and reaction timing, though the game is more survival-score based than completion-time based.
The presentation heavily uses neon arcade visuals, pink/cyan glow, and a futuristic skyline, making this a stylistically appropriate secondary classification.
